name: Conversation start
responsibility: Starts a conversation on a pane's first message or Talk: the tab's coordinator ready first, then the workhorse of the shown checkout, then board news to it
description: A coordinator that cannot start refuses the message or Talk with its reason, and no workhorse starts. New conversation replaces the workhorse of the shown checkout only and keeps the tab's coordinator, which speaks for every workhorse of the tab. The old workhorse thread is given up and Codex unloads it once no turn runs on it. A delegation to a checkout whose workhorse has no thread that can run turns starts that thread the same way, but leaves the coordinator alone: it is running the turn that gives the work.

outgoing.label: make the tab coordinator ready first, keep it after
then start the workhorse of the shown checkout
move board news to the new workhorse
claim its threads, retire the old workhorse
read the pane's link before starting anything
